name: refactor_flask_extract_service
description: Extracts pricing logic duplicated across two Flask routes into a service module
prompts: app/routes/quotes.py duplicates the same discount-pricing computation in both the /quote and /quote/bulk handlers (subtotal = unitPrice*quantity; 20% off for quantity>=100, 10% off for quantity>=10, else none; total and subtotal rounded to 2 decimals). Refactor by extracting the pricing into a NEW module app/services.py (e.g. compute_quote(unit_price, quantity) -> dict) and rewire BOTH handlers in app/routes/quotes.py to call it, so the pricing rule exists in exactly one place. The HTTP behavior of both endpoints must stay identical.

setup_files.app/__init__.py:
from flask import Flask

from app.routes.quotes import quotes_bp


def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.register_blueprint(quotes_bp)
    return app

test_setup_files.test_quotes.py:
from app import create_app

client = create_app().test_client()

assert client.post("/quote", json={"unitPrice": 10, "quantity": 5}).get_json() == \
    {"subtotal": 50.0, "discount": 0.0, "total": 50.0}
assert client.post("/quote", json={"unitPrice": 10, "quantity": 10}).get_json() == \
    {"subtotal": 100.0, "discount": 0.1, "total": 90.0}
assert client.post("/quote", json={"unitPrice": 2, "quantity": 100}).get_json() == \
    {"subtotal": 200.0, "discount": 0.2, "total": 160.0}

bulk = client.post("/quote/bulk", json=[
    {"unitPrice": 10, "quantity": 5},
    {"unitPrice": 10, "quantity": 10},
    {"unitPrice": 10, "quantity": 100},
]).get_json()
assert bulk == [
    {"subtotal": 50.0, "discount": 0.0, "total": 50.0},
    {"subtotal": 100.0, "discount": 0.1, "total": 90.0},
    {"subtotal": 1000.0, "discount": 0.2, "total": 800.0},
], bulk
print("behavior PASS")
test_setup_files.check_extracted.py:
from pathlib import Path

router = Path("app/routes/quotes.py").read_text()
assert "compute_quote" in router, "router must call the extracted service"
assert router.count(">= 100") == 0 and router.count(">= 10") == 0, \
    "discount thresholds are still inlined in the router - not extracted"
assert Path("app/services.py").exists(), "app/services.py must exist"
print("structure PASS")
